source_content.description: Our Real Estate Posts is an incredibly convenient solution for any Realtor. The hardware is durable and lightweight enough for a single person to install. The arm, quick-install ground stake, caps, and hanging hardware all fit within the body of the vertical post for compact storage and transport. This product will make displaying a Real Estate sign easy and dig-free. The Single Arm Vinyl Post is a great exterior sign frame for real estate and directional signs. Offered with our 3mm PVC and 3mm Double-sided White Aluminum Sandwich board makes it quick to change out signage or move the location of your signage with ease.Optional Rider Signs are sold separately under the Rider Sign Category.Hardware 6 foot Single Arm Vinyl Post Decorative Gothic Cap 2 Rider Clips Mounting Hardware Steel Post Stake (4”X34”) Vinyl Arm (2”X3.5”X40”) Vinyl Post (4”X4”X72”)
